title: Playback Policy And Renderer Targets
problem: Nako has Library Access and a Playback Planner, but it lacks explicit per-user playback permissions and renderer target capabilities for direct, remux, transcode, remote, and future casting decisions.

evidence.summary: Opened the playback policy and renderer target lane, capturing Jellyfin-class user policy, device profile, playback-info, session, and cast receiver pressure while keeping Nako's policy/target/planner boundaries original.

Added characterization coverage proving current playback gates only on Library Access Play: a Play-scoped viewer can request direct/remux/HLS browser tickets, remux app execution has no principal/policy input, and remote context is not a permission gate in the planner.

Added playback permission policy, effective policy, target kind/network/transport/control vocabulary in nako-core and planner-facing PlaybackTarget records in nako-playback, with tests for defaults, denial reasons, and target transport separation.

continue_policy.notes: Continue through PRT-020..PRT-070 while the policy/target boundary remains valid. Start casting-renderer-runtime only after this lane proves policy-aware target planning.
